facts.text: Invite Spamuel to gather wood for a little shelter
Tell him about your day while he works, then ask him to stop and tell you where he stopped.
Ask him to select a shelter site and resume work there.
Change the job while it is underway: meet back at the first site.
Ask him to inspect yesterday's work and recall which parts you discussed.
Ask what actually changed in the world and what remains an idea.
